crossRefs.note: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor the brook of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring…
David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there…
The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of…
Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Son of Hezron, descendant of Judah

people.name: Ephrathah
people.line: A wife of Caleb and founder of Bethlehem.

people.name: Hur
people.line: A companion of Moses and grandfather of Bezalel.

people.name: Kiriath-jearim
people.line: A city where the ark resided

people.name: Shobal
people.line: Son of Hur, founder of Kiriath-jearim, Judahite descendant.

translations.web: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
translations.bsb: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,
translations.kjv: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim,
translations.asv: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the first-born of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,
